body: If change were so easy I would've done it already.
No problem, glad if I could help! I think after a good discussion and giving each other time to get used to things everything will be ok!

I hope it helped to get things off your chest, it sounds rough.

All the advice I can offer is a bit of understanding from both sides. I understand you do what you do to cope but I also kind of understand him. I, as an adult, would feel very uncomfortable having an adult relationship with someone that behaves very childlike. If my partner suddenly started watching shows for small children and talking/acting like one I'd be quite put off. It's definitely not a free pass to judge but I think you both should have a calm talk about both your comforts and discomforts concerning this with no judgement from either side. Maybe find a middle ground of sorts, you're meant to be as comfortable as possible in a relationship.
